title: Miftah tutorial 48 · End a contract early: terminate, settle and refund
description:
Terminate a contract on the move-out date, return the cheques dated after it, settle the deposit with a deduction and pay the Tenant's refund from the building's bank account.

Who this is for: Accountant, Company Admin, Property Manager.
